summary: Explains kubernetes.core.k8s_config_resource_name for getting a ConfigMap or Secret name with its hash, for use in Pod specs like envFrom secretRef.
questions: How do I reference a hashed ConfigMap name in a Kubernetes deployment with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Kubernetes resource names with hash
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ configmap_resource_definition | kubernetes.core.k8s_config_resource_name }}
```

Use it in Pod specs:

```yaml
envFrom:
  - secretRef:
      name: {{ my_secret | kubernetes.core.k8s_config_resource_name }}
```

Requires the kubernetes.core collection.
